gpt-image-2.summary: The cleanest re-render in the field. Nothing moved, nothing was re-clad, and the material response is genuinely photographic rather than a tidied render.

massing: pass
Curved-top tower, fin-clad slab behind and the stepped podium all sit at the same size and relative position as the source; the cantilevered terraces keep their exact profile.
camera: pass
Framing, horizon and apparent focal length are indistinguishable from the source.
materiality: pass
Glass curtain wall, the bronze louvred box on the right and the white vertical fins on the podium volumes are all on the same surfaces as the source.
lighting: pass
Clear daylight with shadows falling in the same direction and length as the source.
photoreal: pass
Glass carries believable multi-layer reflection and the podium materials have real microdetail; reads as photography rather than a real-time render.
street_life: pass
Vehicles along the street edge, planting to the kerb and lit retail signage all present and correctly scaled.
signage_integrity: The SIGNAGE block on the left reads cleanly and the green LED screen is preserved intact.

gpt-image-1.5.summary: The most photographic image in the task and the least faithful. The camera dollied in and the podium was substantially redesigned — a beautiful picture of a different building.

massing: fail
The fin-clad slab behind is replaced by a stepped glass volume, the bronze louvred box becomes a boxier dark mass, and the terrace levels are restructured.
camera: fail
Camera has dollied in and dropped; the podium fills far more of the frame and the horizon sits lower than the source.
materiality: partial
Glass and gold soffits survive, but the white vertical fins that define the podium volumes are largely gone.
lighting: pass
Daylight retained with shadows still cast from the upper left, consistent with the source sun.
photoreal: pass
Convincingly photographic — atmospheric depth, crowd detail and believable glass; the strongest photoreal read of the thirteen.
street_life: pass
Dense vehicles, street trees, planting and signage, plus a populated ground plane.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE lettering is legible and the green screen survives as coherent imagery.

Nano Banana 2.summary: Dollied in and re-clad the left tower from glass to bronze fins. Handsome and lively, but two of the instruction's three named materials moved.

massing: partial
The three principal volumes remain in the right relative positions, but the middle tower is reshaped into an angular white-finned mass and the podium volumes are rearranged.
camera: fail
Clear dolly forward — the building fills substantially more of the frame and the ground plane sits much closer than the source.
materiality: partial
The left tower's glass curtain wall has been re-clad in dark bronze vertical fins; bronze and white fins appear elsewhere but on the wrong surfaces.
lighting: pass
Daylight held with shadow direction matching the source.
photoreal: pass
Strongly photographic — populated pavements, traffic and convincing atmospheric falloff on the background towers.
street_life: pass
Buses, cars, pedestrians, street trees and multiple signage zones.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE reads cleanly; the green screen is swapped for a photographic billboard but no lettering is garbled.

Nano Banana 2 Lite.summary: Holds the building almost exactly, but barely lifts the image beyond the source render — the cheapest way to keep your geometry and the least photoreal gain.

massing: pass
All volumes present at source proportions and positions; the terrace profiles and podium stepping are intact.
camera: pass
Framing and horizon match the source.
materiality: pass
Glass, the olive-bronze louvred box and the white podium fins are all on their original surfaces.
lighting: pass
Daylight preserved with consistent shadow direction.
photoreal: partial
Only a marginal uplift on the source — sky gradient and glass improve slightly, but the podium still reads as a real-time render rather than photography.
street_life: pass
Vehicles along the street, planting and signage all present.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE legible and the green LED screen preserved.

Nano Banana Pro.summary: Geometrically faithful and materially correct, but the photoreal uplift is restrained — a cleaner render more than a photograph.

massing: pass
Every volume holds its silhouette, floor count and position; terraces and podium stepping unchanged.
camera: pass
Near-identical framing and horizon, with only a negligible tightening.
materiality: pass
Glass curtain wall, bronze louvred box and white vertical fins all correctly placed.
lighting: pass
Daylight and shadow direction consistent with the source.
photoreal: partial
Crisper than the source but retains flat ambient shading across the podium; the glass lacks the layered reflection that reads as photographic. The green LED screen is also dropped to plain facade.
street_life: pass
Vehicles, street planting and signage present at plausible scale.

FLUX.2 Max.summary: The most atmospheric daylight of the field, achieved by quietly reproportioning the towers and relocating the bronze box. High craft, mid fidelity.

massing: partial
Composition is recognisable, but the left tower reads taller and more slender, the fin-clad slab becomes a dark angular mass, and the bronze louvred box is resized and shifted right.
camera: partial
Slight dolly forward — the building sits larger in frame, with added foreground street furniture compressing the depth.
materiality: partial
Glass is preserved and enriched, but the muted bronze louvre becomes saturated solid gold and the middle tower's white fins darken.
lighting: pass
Warm daylight with shadow direction matching the source sun.
photoreal: pass
Outstanding — overhead wires, traffic signals, wet specular highlights and true material microdetail throughout.
street_life: pass
Cars, planting, pedestrians and multiple retail signage zones.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE reads correctly; smaller retail lettering is invented but coherent rather than scrambled.

Grok Imagine Image 2.0.summary: Near-top fidelity at roughly ten seconds a generation. Only a slight tightening of frame separates it from the perfect scores.

massing: pass
All volumes present at correct proportions and positions; terrace cantilevers and podium stepping intact.
camera: partial
Angle is held exactly but the frame is modestly tighter — the building occupies more of the canvas than the source.
materiality: pass
Glass, the bronze-olive louvred box and the white podium fins all correctly placed.
lighting: pass
Daylight with matching shadow direction; added cloud does not alter the sun position.
photoreal: pass
Crisp and photographic — convincing glass reflection, foliage detail and depth on the background towers.
street_life: pass
Cars, auto-rickshaws, pedestrians, street trees and planting throughout.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE legible and the green LED screen preserved.

massing: pass

camera: pass

materiality: pass

lighting: pass

photoreal: pass

street_life: pass

camera: pass

lighting: pass
Daylight preserved with consistent shadow direction.
photoreal: pass
Warm, crisp render with believable glass and material depth.
street_life: pass

lighting: pass
Daylight with shadow direction consistent with the source.
photoreal: pass
Crisp and warm with convincing glass and foliage detail.
street_life: pass
